address: 5F, 301 Lequn 3rd Road, Zhongshan District, Taipei, Taiwan
bio: From appetisers and hot dishes to nigiri and desserts, the thoughtfully curated menu embodies kaiseki artistry, together with a host of surprising intricate details. Nigiri sushi are elegantly delivered to the table in a bespoke wooden box instead of on a plate or platter. Equally noteworthy is the chef and his wife’s warm, personalised hospitality as they graciously unveil each course.
